N2.description: P-PRINCIPAL/D-16: the transport chain admits a caller with no user, so no session reaches the gateway and slot 2's in-array refusal is the only thing left (G2-IN, E-INDEP). Shared: a set is named by a killer, never applied on its own.

N4.description: U4: the two mechanisms that shadow slot 4 — `findRecord`'s tenant filter, and slot 3's principal compare. Re-quoted against the gateway AS MERGED (P-PRINCIPAL rewrote slot 3, D-16); slot 3's new null-principal branch needs no neutraliser, because the request under test carries a principal that resolves — it is the RECORD that belongs to another tenant.

N6-FLOOR.description: U6-L1: Gate 5's level comparison is neutralised — the RETURN VALUE of the shadowing check is replaced, never a line deleted (§0.5 E-INDEP). A TOOL ref and an unregistered C9 key both derive STEP_UP_VERIFIED (K4 fail-closed), which a pwa session cannot meet, so on a conformant build they stop at slot 5 and never reach Gate 6. With this set they reach it, and S-TOOL / S-REG read Gate 6's own DETAIL.
